_note: Baidu photos of aircraft parked at the terminal, plus an Esri World Imagery satellite view.

hfe-baidu-1.webp.zh: 机坪上：一架中国东方航空客机停在廊桥旁，后方航站楼屋顶立着红色的“合肥”与“HEFEI”标识，左侧是塔台。
hfe-baidu-1.webp.en: On the apron, a China Eastern airliner at the gate below the red Hefei and HEFEI lettering on the terminal roof, with the control tower to the left.

hfe-baidu-2.webp.zh: 一架中国国际航空的宽体客机停在机坪上，机身后方是合肥新桥机场金黄色的航站楼屋顶。
hfe-baidu-2.webp.en: An Air China wide-body airliner on the apron, the golden roof of Hefei Xinqiao's terminal behind it.

hfe-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，合肥新桥国际机场（HFE）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
hfe-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Hefei Xinqiao International Airport (HFE) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
